sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drinks_fts" USING fts5(drink_id UNINDEXED, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drink_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_profile" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_volume_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drinks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "type_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES drink_types (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "producer" TEXT NULL, "appellation" TEXT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "grapes" TEXT NULL, "abv" REAL NULL, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "comment" TEXT NULL, "needs_completion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_completion" IN (0, 1)), "food_pairing" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "characteristic_families" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drink_types (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "characteristics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES characteristic_families (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drink_characteristics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "drink_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drinks (id), "characteristic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES characteristics (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "drink_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drinks (id), "vintage" INTEGER NULL, "volume_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "location" TEXT NULL, "drink_from" INTEGER NULL, "drink_before" INTEGER NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE VIEW drink_search_rows AS SELECT d.id AS drink_id, d.name AS name, d.producer AS producer, d.appellation AS appellation, d.region AS region, d.country AS country, d.grapes AS grapes, (SELECT t.name FROM drink_types AS t WHERE t.id = d.type_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS type_name, (SELECT group_concat(c.name, ' ') FROM drink_characteristics AS dc JOIN characteristics AS c ON c.id = dc.characteristic_id WHERE dc.drink_id = d.id AND dc.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS characteristics, (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT l.vintage) FROM lots AS l WHERE l.drink_id = d.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS vintages FROM drinks AS d

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON drinks BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON drinks BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON drinks BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_link_insert AFTER INSERT ON drink_characteristics BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_link_update AFTER UPDATE ON drink_characteristics BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_lot_insert AFTER INSERT ON lots BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_lot_update AFTER UPDATE OF vintage, deleted_at ON lots BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id = new.drink_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_type_update AFTER UPDATE ON drink_types BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id IN (SELECT id FROM drinks WHERE type_id = new.id);INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id IN (SELECT id FROM drinks WHERE type_id = new.id);END

CREATE TRIGGER drinks_fts_characteristic_update AFTER UPDATE ON characteristics BEGIN DELETE FROM drinks_fts WHERE drink_id IN (SELECT drink_id FROM drink_characteristics WHERE characteristic_id = new.id);INSERT INTO drinks_fts (drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages) SELECT drink_id, name, producer, appellation, region, country, grapes, type_name, characteristics, vintages FROM drink_search_rows WHERE drink_id IN (SELECT drink_id FROM drink_characteristics WHERE characteristic_id = new.id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lots (id), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_families_type ON characteristic_families (type_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_characteristics_family ON characteristics (family_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_drinks_type ON drinks (type_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_drink_characteristics_drink ON drink_characteristics (drink_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_lots_drink ON lots (drink_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_lots_barcode ON lots (barcode)
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_lot ON movements (lot_id, occurred_at)
